allowed_scope: Read-only frozen application and public official-source snapshots; static reasoning and compilation only; evidence writes outside repository
inspected_controls: Hosted filesystem creation and SQLite schema execution are guarded by not HOSTED; hosted conn selects PostgreSQL with no local fallback or cold-start DDL.
Global middleware requires complete PG/private-storage/auth configuration and validates exact configured Host plus HTTPS before Basic authentication; all app/static/docs/API routes share middleware.
Unsafe methods require password-keyed per-origin token; supplied Origin or Referer must match exact trusted request origin. No CORS response grants are introduced.
Authenticated ContextVar principal overrides typed reviewers and every audit actor; UI renders principal readonly and supplies mutation token after authenticated health.

PostgreSQL SQL values stay bound through qmark adapter; explicit insertion ID whitelist uses RETURNING id; identity/schema foreign-key order and integer/text representations align with application access.
Database routes use single serializable transactions with statement and lock limits; concurrency errors map to 409 and provider transport errors to redacted 503 without silent retry.
Migration is explicit --apply, transaction/advisory locked, digest marked, requires empty dedicated tables on first run, and has no DROP/ALTER/local database import.

Private upload endpoint, request headers and URL shape agree with locally inspected pinned vercel/storage source; no redirects, no public return URL, no read/browser tokens, and conservative retention after ambiguous database commit.

Native Python builder maps app/main.py to dotted app.main; installed builder static-discovery source uses importlib with project root and documents deployed parity. Namespace package app is valid without __init__.py.
Runtime module/static-file upload allowlist and function exclusions omit source archives, knowledge, receipts, scripts, SQL files, customer data, dotenv and local Vercel account state.
Core currency, source/evidence hashing, historical-snapshot validation and spreadsheet literal handling have identical ASTs to the repaired baseline.
operational_observations: Health proves only one organizations-table read and configuration shapes; actual private Blob authorization and full migrated schema must be verified on connected services.
Hosted object retention deliberately permits orphaned private objects after failures; cleanup/reconciliation remains a manual operating task until a future feature is added.
No authenticated original-PDF retrieval route exists; this predates hosting. Owner must retain originals or use authorized provider/operator retrieval for source review.
